generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The test assertion in `testRecoverySourceWithLogs` has been changed to verify the presence and value of `_recovery_source_size`, whereas other similar tests (e.g., `#42B43`, `#01ZGN`, `#R41SJ`) simply remove the feature flag conditional and assert that `_recovery_source` is null. This introduces an inconsistency in expected behavior for LogsDB mode compared to the rest of the suite and deviates from the pattern of simply adopting the "enabled" path of the previous conditional logic.

review_comment: Does this cause issues during upgrade?
No, since the feature flag is now completely removed and so regular index version checks avoid issue during upgrades.
